title: ervum cyprium
intro: Ervum cyprium, commonly known as Cypriot lentil or Cypriot ervum, is a plant species in the legume family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce blood pressure due to its high content of fiber and other nutrients. The therapeutic actions of Ervum cyprium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, that possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Ervum cyprium have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications in the treatment of various diseases, including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer.
